stem_book: A rod AB of mass 100 kg and length 1 m is rotated about an axis passing through A and making an angle 30° with the length of the rod. The M.O.I. of the rod about the given axis is x kg-m². Find x.
reason: Coordinator: printed 'x 10^-3' removed from the data to fit the key - not used. print says 'x × 10⁻³' but with 100 kg the MOI is 8.33 kg m² (printed key 8.33); the stray ×10⁻³ is dropped (twin L4 Q2 also uses 100 kg).
